newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-GRAND NATIONAL WINNER ROUGH QUEST SIDELINED.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-GRAND NATIONAL WINNER ROUGH QUEST SIDELINED.

text.p: Rough Quest's bid to defend his Grand National title in April as well as improve on his second in the Cheltenham Gold Cup next month is in doubt following a leg injury during a weekend workout.
A spokeswoman for trainer Terry Casey said on Tuesday inflammation had been detected and the horse was being confined to his box.
''As in the norm in such cases, we shall feel our way along one day at the time and, hopefully, we shall be in better position to evaluate the situation in a week's time, '' she said.

Rough Quest has made two appearances this season. Having missed an intended preparatory race at Haydock which was called off due to frost, he successfully reverted to hurdles at Folkestone in December.
Despite not having run over the smaller obstacles since May 1991, Rough Quest looked better than ever, winning easily.
There was much deliberation before Rough Quest was given the go ahead to contest the King George VI Chase at Kempton on Boxing Day, owing to the firm state of the ground.
After inspecting the track, the green light was finally given with Rough Quest finishing a respectable 12 lengths second to One Man.
